description: Per-field options for a wildcard term-level clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed wildcard map (the map key is the column name).

value.description: Optional. The wildcard pattern (* matches any sequence, ? matches a single character). A string. Either value or wildcard supplies the pattern.

wildcard.description: Optional. Alias for value — the wildcard pattern. A string.

case_insensitive.description: Optional. When true, matches the pattern regardless of case. Default false.

rewrite.description: Optional. How the multi-term query is rewritten internally.
